properties.title: 712 S Crockett St, Sherman, TX 75090
properties.description:
Constructed with historic character and completely updated with modern interior appointments, 712 S Crockett St is an attractive single-family home offering 1,412 square feet of single-story living in Sherman along the North Texas US-75 growth corridor. A broad covered front veranda greets visitors, opening into an expansive open-concept living and dining space enriched by recessed LED lighting, neutral color palettes, and durable wood-look plank flooring.

The kitchen features quartz countertops, white shaker cabinets, modern hardware, and a stainless steel appliance suite including a refrigerator, electric range and oven, dishwasher, and microwave. Two full bathrooms have been comprehensively remodeled with contemporary vanities, polished chrome fixtures, and custom ceramic tile surrounds. Both bedrooms offer peaceful layouts with abundant natural lighting and sizable closets. Dedicated washer and dryer hookups are located in a private utility room.

Outside, the property occupies a generous quarter-acre parcel (11,025 square feet) with mature perimeter shade trees, a private concrete driveway, and an expansive fenced backyard ideal for pets and outdoor living. Situated within easy walking distance of local shops, dining, and Austin College, this home offers classic charm with modern convenience. Application Fee: $50. Pet-Friendly.
amenities: Covered Front Veranda with Decorative Railing

properties.title: 2832 Avenue I, Fort Worth, TX 76105
properties.description:
Full of authentic architectural charm and modernized for daily comfort, 2832 Avenue I is an inviting single-family bungalow offering 902 square feet of functional living space in Fort Worth. A wide covered front porch extends a warm welcome, leading directly into an airy living room highlighted by gleaming hardwood floors, crisp trim, and tall double-hung windows that capture bright southwestern exposure throughout the afternoon.

The kitchen is organized with generous wood cabinetry, durable laminate countertops, a classic tile backsplash, and appliances including a refrigerator, gas range and oven, and overhead vent hood. The eat-in dining nook connects seamlessly to the cooking area for casual meals. Two restful bedrooms feature original hardwood flooring, ceiling fans, and well-proportioned wardrobe closets. The central bathroom offers clean ceramic tilework, an updated modern vanity, and a shower-tub combination. Dedicated laundry hookups are located in a convenient rear utility alcove.

Outside, the property provides an expansive 6,247-square-foot parcel complete with perimeter fencing, mature trees, and a detached garage/workshop suitable for vehicle parking, gear storage, or creative projects. Located minutes from Texas Wesleyan University, downtown Fort Worth, and I-287, this detached residence delivers outstanding privacy and character. Application Fee: $50. Pet-Friendly.

properties.title: 5624 Shady Springs Trl, Fort Worth, TX 76179
properties.description:
Situated in a quiet residential neighborhood in North Fort Worth near Saginaw, 5624 Shady Springs Trl is a single-story ranch residence providing 1,170 square feet of comfortable living area. The open floor plan unfolds into a vaulted living room with high architectural ceilings, low-maintenance wood-look vinyl plank flooring, and a handsome central fireplace that creates an inviting centerpiece for leisure and entertainment.

The kitchen features ample prep countertops, solid wood cabinets, a stainless steel sink overlooking the yard, and a complete appliance package including a refrigerator, electric range with oven, built-in microwave, and multi-cycle dishwasher. The adjoining dining area opens through sliding glass doors to the rear grounds. Both bedrooms feature ceiling fans and generous closet storage, while the central bathroom offers an updated vanity and a tub-shower combination. A separate utility space provides full washer and dryer connections.

Exterior highlights include a fully fenced backyard with established shade trees and an open lawn perfect for outdoor dining and pets, alongside an attached two-car garage offering secure vehicle parking and overhead storage. With quick access to Loop 820, US-287, and local community parks, this detached single-family home offers everyday convenience. Application Fee: $50. Pet-Friendly.
amenities: Private Fenced Backyard Lawn with Shade Trees

properties.title: 1856 Carl St, Fort Worth, TX 76103
properties.description:

The home retains its architectural warmth while showcasing contemporary upgrades, beginning with an inviting covered front porch and an expansive living room featuring fresh designer paint and continuous wood-look flooring.

The renovated kitchen features quartz countertops, classic shaker cabinetry, custom tile backsplashes, and stainless steel appliances including a refrigerator, gas cooktop and oven, dishwasher, and microwave. Uniquely offering two full modernized bathrooms, the home ensures complete privacy with custom tilework, modern vanity mirrors, and upgraded plumbing fixtures. Both bedrooms are generously sized with ceiling fans and ample wardrobe storage. An interior laundry area includes an in-unit washer and dryer.

The exterior grounds are a rare standout, boasting an expansive fenced yard with mature native trees, an open concrete rear patio, and a covered carport accessible via a private gated driveway. Conveniently positioned near Meadowbrook Golf Course, I-30, and downtown Fort Worth, this home offers exceptional space and privacy. Application Fee: $50. Pet-Friendly.

properties.title: 421 N 3rd St, Jacksboro, TX 76458
properties.description:
Characterized by welcoming traditional architecture, 421 N 3rd St is a spacious two-story single-family home providing 1,478 square feet of finished living space in Jacksboro. A generous covered front porch extends across the facade, leading into a light-filled living room featuring durable wood-look laminate flooring, large sash windows, and an easy flow toward the formal dining and kitchen spaces.

The kitchen is equipped with ample prep counters, solid wood cabinetry, a dual-basin sink, and appliances including a refrigerator, electric range with oven, dishwasher, and microwave. The home features two full bathrooms plus an additional main-level half-bath for guests. Each bedroom offers private en-suite bathroom access, generous closet storage, and ceiling fans. A dedicated laundry room provides washer and dryer hookups with supplemental utility shelving.

Outside, the 8,233-square-foot homesite features mature pecan trees, a covered parking carport, and a spacious rear yard suitable for outdoor gatherings and pets. Positioned moments from the town square, Fort Richardson State Historic Site, and TX-199, this home offers spacious residential comfort in North Texas. Application Fee: $50. Pet-Friendly.

properties.title: 13324 Pandora Cir, Dallas, TX 75238
properties.description:
Nestled in the Lake Highlands enclave bordering Richardson, 13324 Pandora Cir is an architectural two-story townhome offering 1,589 square feet of thoughtfully arranged living space. The main level welcomes you into an open living room centered around a clean contemporary fireplace, recessed display shelving, and tall sliding glass doors that open directly onto a private walled courtyard patio. Crisp neutral paint pairs smoothly with durable wood-plank flooring throughout the core living and dining zones.

The kitchen is designed for seamless meal preparation, featuring clean solid countertops, abundant upper and lower cabinetry, and complete appliances including a stainless steel refrigerator, electric range and oven, multi-cycle dishwasher, and built-in microwave. A convenient powder room vanity serves visitors on the ground level. Upstairs, two expansive dual-primary suites each feature dedicated private full en-suite bathrooms, oversized mirrored vanities, and deep walk-in closet space. In-unit washer and dryer units are positioned in an upstairs laundry closet.

Exterior living highlights a tranquil paved courtyard garden patio connecting the home directly to an attached two-car garage with automated entry. Located minutes from White Rock Lake, Lake Highlands town center, and North Central Expressway (US-75), this residence offers effortless access across the Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex. Application Fee: $50. Pet-Friendly.

properties.title: 3326 Briaroaks Dr, Garland, TX 75044
properties.description:

The adjoining kitchen features bright white cabinetry, durable tile flooring, breakfast bar seating, and a complete appliance lineup including a stainless steel refrigerator, electric range and oven, built-in dishwasher, and microwave. properties.title: 205 Private Road 6980, Alba, TX 75410
properties.description:
Resting on nearly two pristine wooded acres (84,245 square feet) in Alba near world-renowned Lake Fork, 205 Private Road 6980 is a custom single-story country home delivering 1,736 square feet of peaceful residential living. Built in 2005, the interior opens into an impressive great room accentuated by soaring vaulted ceilings, rustic exposed cedar beams, and expansive picture windows framing panoramic woodland views.

The culinary center features an open layout with an expansive prep island, solid oak cabinetry, ceramic tile floors, and a complete appliance package including refrigerator, electric range and oven, dishwasher, and built-in microwave. The primary suite serves as a serene private retreat, complete with a walk-in wardrobe and an en-suite bath featuring a deep garden soaking tub, separate shower, and double vanity. The secondary bedroom is equally generous, supported by a full hall bathroom. An interior laundry room comes equipped with an in-unit washer and dryer.

Exterior living is defined by total privacy, offering covered front and rear verandas surrounded by mature pine and hardwood trees, alongside an attached two-car garage with extensive parking for vehicles, boats, and outdoor gear. Located just off US-69, this property offers unmatched acreage living. Application Fee: $50. Pet-Friendly.

The kitchen is equipped with polished granite countertops, crisp white cabinetry, a white subway tile backsplash, a pantry closet, and stainless steel appliances including a refrigerator, smooth-top electric range, dishwasher, and microwave. Outdoors, enjoy a private fenced backyard with a covered patio for quiet evenings, as well as an attached single-car garage and private driveway.
